name: Marq
description: Marq is a brand templating platform where teams create and distribute on-brand documents like flyers, one-pagers, brochures, datasheets, and social posts. This connector lets Claude read and edit those documents directly: survey a project’s pages, text, images, and smart fields; rewrite, proofread, or translate copy in place; apply a brand kit’s colors, fonts, and logos; populate documents from your Marq datasets; and export finished files as PDF or PNG. Edits respect the template’s existing styling and element locks, so brand and layout integrity hold even when the agent is doing the work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Marq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Marq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.marq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Marq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marq lists 43 MCP tools, including brand_GetBrandKit, conversion_ExportDocument, data_FindDataItems, data_GetCollectionSchema, data_GetDataSetSamples, data_GetDataSetSchema, data_ListDataSets, dmes_ApplyBranding, dmes_ApplyDataSmartFields, dmes_ApplyProjectSmartFields, dmes_ApplyTeamSmartFields, and dmes_ApplyUserSmartFields.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Marq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Marq in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Marq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Marq is developed by Marq. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
